title: Yugo Aosaki's Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Live-Action Series With Worldwide Distribution on Amazon Prime Video
content:
Amazon Prime Video announced on Monday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a live-action adaptation titled Rock Paper Landmine that will stream on the service worldwide starting on November 13.

The show will star Nana Mori as Mato Imoriya and Aju Makita as Kazahi Koda.

Kazuaki Seki is directing the series. Tatsuhiro Mishima, Shiori Ueno, and Daiki Kobayashi are writing the scripts, and Yuma Yamaguchi is composing the music. The Seven is producing the series and Akira Morii is the producer.

Kadokawa published the original novel in November 2023. The novel won three awards in 2024: the novel division of the 24th "Honkaku Mystery Taisho" (Orthodox Mystery Award) award, the "full-length novel or collected short stories" division of the 77th "Nihon Suiri Sakka Kyōkai Shō" (Mystery Writers of Japan Awards) award, and the 37th "Yamamoto Shūgorō Prize" award.

The Seven describes the story:

"Rock-Paper-Scissors," "Memory"... universally known simple games transform into the ultimate battles of strategy and psychology with just a few added rules! Mato Imoriya, a seemingly carefree high school girl with an uncanny talent for winning any game, plunges into underground school game battles to save her best friend, Kazahi Koda. What they stake isn't their "lives." It is their urgent "everyday lives" and "youth"—from securing prime spots for school festival booths to competing for 90 million yen worth of chips among students. High-level logic where a single step can be fatal, off-board tactics to outwit each other, and brilliant turnarounds that calmly flip the board from desperate situations. A "bloodless survival game" by high school girls who risk losing all their youth instead of their lives. The curtain rises on a thrilling, high-stakes battle-of-wits drama combining unpredictable tension with the catharsis of completely outwitting opponents!

Medaka Box artist Akira Akatsuki launched a manga adaptation of the novels in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine October 2024. The manga is ongoing and Hakusensha published the fourth volume on May 29.

Yugo Aosaki 's Undead Girl Murder Farce novels launched in 2015. Kodansha published the novel's third volume in April 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the novels' manga adaptation. The novels inspired a television anime adaptation that debuted in July 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series worldwide excluding Asia as it aired in Japan under the title Undead Murder Farce .

title: Adventure Time: Side Quests Beats The Original Series At Its Own Game
content:
Ever since Adventure Time debuted on Cartoon Network in 2010, the franchise has become a monolith for the cable network. Garnering over two hundred and eighty episodes in its original run, the Land of Oooo refused to die as multiple side stories were created. Distant Lands and Fionna & Cake wove wild new stories that further expanded on Adventure Time’s world, but arguably, Side Quests is the series that has taken things back to basics. If you’re a fan of Finn and Jake, the latest prequel series hits a home run while still staying true to what worked so well with the beloved franchise’s first series.

One of the biggest positives for Side Quests , much like Regular Show: The Lost Tapes , is that nearly the full cast has returned to reprise their roles. While Finn’s voice actor changed, thanks to the original VA aging out of the role, every other character sounds exactly as we left them. Considering Side Quests takes place only a few short years before Adventure Time first started, this fact is an important one. Since Adventure Time ended in 2018, the spin-off series has mostly focused on brand new parts of Oooo, whether that be the afterlife and/or the multiverse. What Side Quests does so well is take viewers back to what the original perfected, but there is one major change that the spin-off has perfected from its source.

Side Quests’ New Spin

Even from looking at Side Quests’ images, viewers can immediately notice that this prequel looks quite different from the original Adventure Time . While the first Cartoon Network series used 2-D animation for the Land of Oooo, this follow-up goes with a more CG approach, and it shockingly works quite well. Without the outlines on characters and the more fluid approach, Oooo pops quite a bit more than what fans first witnessed. Surprisingly enough, this also helps hammer home the impact of both the hilarity and the action that both Finn and Jake have been known for. If you were “put off” by the switch in animation from the original trailers, don’t be, as this definitely feels like a case of “the more things change, the more they stay the same.”

One major element that Side Quests trails behind the original Adventure Time is its overall episode count. As mentioned at the start of this write-up, the first series had over two hundred and eighty episodes, with only forty in total confirmed for the prequel so far. With other spin-offs already confirmed, like Heyo BMO! and a feature-length film in the works, Side Quests will be in good company, even if it only totals forty installments when all is said and done.

title: Kemono Jihen Manga Goes on Hiatus After Brother of Creator Shō Aimoto Dies
content:
The 25th compiled book volume, which shipped on August 4, revealed that the series will end in the next volume.

Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Inugami is a Tokyo detective who specializes in the occult. One day, answering a call to a remote village leads him to Dorotabo: a peculiar boy nicknamed after a yokai that haunts muddy rice paddies. The boy has no parents and is somewhat unnerving, emitting a foul odor that draws the ire of those around him. Inugami, however, quickly realizes that there's something more monstrous about Dorotabo than just his nickname–a fact proven when the two of them investigate an inhuman creature attacking local livestock. Perhaps Inugami can take this mistreated boy under his wing and train him to face the secret, supernatural beasts hidden in the world...using the eerie powers of his own body.

Aimoto launched the manga in Jump SQ. in December 2016 Seven Seas released the 21st volume in English on June 23. The manga inspired a television anime that premiered in January 2021.

The series took a one-issue break in February. Aimoto shared the announcement on her X (formerly Twitter) account, and stated that she had gastroenteritis at the beginning of the year. Aimoto added that she is feeling better now and will also get an endoscopy soon.

title: Kotaro Lives Alone Author Mami Tsumura Launches New Manga
content:
This year's 18th issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine announced on Friday Mami Tsumura will launch a new manga titled Tanosuke no Kawazanyō (Tanosuke's Overly Optimistic Estimation) in the 19th issue on September 11.

Tsumura launched the Ore no Baa-san (My Granny) story originally as a one-shot in 2025, before it launched as a manga series in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Original magazine in March 2026. The series is ongoing, and is also available on the Big Comics website .

Tsumura launched the Kotarō wa Hitori Gurashi ( Kotaro Lives Alone ) manga in Big Comic Superior in 2015. The manga ended in June 2023. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th and final compiled book volume in August 2023. The series won an Electronic Manga Award in 2018.

The manga inspired a live-action series that debuted in April 2021. A second season premiered in April 2023.

The manga also inspired a Netflix anime series that debuted in March 2022.

title: Blaze of Flesh and Blood Manga Ends in September
content:
The October issue of Ichijinsha 's Comic Zero Sum magazine announced on Friday honomi 's manga adaptation of Hana Yakou 's Blaze of Flesh and Blood ( Rekka no Ketsuzoku ) light novel series will end in the November issue, which ships on September 28.

Kodansha USA will publish the manga in English starting in January 2027, and describes the story:

Physician Roger Baldwin, a member of one of the five great houses, is forced on pain of death to transplant a Philosopher's Stone into a human heart—and aſter 10 failed attempts, he finally succeeds! At the age of 18, the recipient, Mahoro Baldwin, is sent to the Lowen Royal Officers Academy to study magic, and to discover the fate of his adoptive brother and bosom friend Siegfried. But when he arrives on the Isle of Crimson, he soon realizes he has much more to learn than a few spells. At once intimidated and fascinated by the gorgeous upperclassmen Noah St. Johns, Mahoro is drawn ever deeper into a web of intrigue and attraction that he barely comprehends… This magic academy drama unfolds in a gothic fantasy kingdom simmering with class conflict and sexual tension… The epic manga adaptation of the popular light novel begins here!

honomi launched the manga adaptation in Ichijinsha 's Comic Zero Sum magazine in November 2024. Ichijinsha shipped the second compiled book volume on March 31.

Taiyotosho shipped the first novel in December 2019 and shipped the seventh and final novel in June 2023. Chiharu Nara is credited with the character designs.

title: 'Magical★Explorer' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs Second Promo
content:
The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Iris ' Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin-Chara ni Tensei shita kedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru ( Magical Explorer: Reborn as a Side Character in a Fantasy Dating Sim ) light novel unveiled additional cast, staff, a second key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Friday.

The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 12:00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, Tochigi TV, Gunma TV, and BS11, followed by Tohoku Broadcasting, TV Aichi, and Yomiuri TV.

Cast Marino Hanamura: Mai Fuchigami ( Ansatsu Kyoushitsu ) Hatsumi Hanamura: Minami Tsuda ( Kaifuku Jutsushi no Yarinaoshi ) Clarissa: Risa Tsumugi ( BanG Dream! 2nd Season ) Iori Hijiri: Asaki Yuikawa ( Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi ) Rina Katou: Hikaru Tono ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! )

Staff Prop Design: Yaeko Watanabe ( Utawarerumono: Futari no Hakuoro ), Yuukei Yamada ( Fate/strange Fake character design) Monster Design: Naoto Hosoda ( Isekai Suicide Squad character design) Effect Design: Hiroshi Yakou ( Senyoku no Sigrdrifa ) Art Director: Isao Yokoyama ( Marriagetoxin ) Color Design: Eriko Murata ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken (TV) ) Director of Photography: Shinya Kuwahara ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) 3D Director: Haruka Sakaguchi ( Rock wa Lady no Tashinami Deshite ) Special Effects, 2D Works: Keiko Oonishi ( Kimi wa Houkago Insomnia ) Editing: Masahiro Gotou ( Steins;Gate ) Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ) Sound Effects: Toshiya Wada ( Hai to Gensou no Grimgar ) Chief Animation Manager: Gaku Iwasa ( Katanagatari animation producer) Animation Producer: Shinichirou Katou ( High School Fleet )

Singer-songwriter ASCA ( Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Raihousha-hen ) is performing the opening theme "Remedy" and ending theme "Double Wings." The opening theme is previewed in the second promotional video below.

Kazuki Oohashi ( Shadows House ) is directing the anime at White Fox , with Satoko Sekine ( Manaria Friends ) handling the series composition. Ryousuke Kimiya ( Zero kara Hajimeru Mahou no Sho ) is designing the characters. Kenichiro Suehiro ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) is composing the music.

Iris originally began writing the adventure comedy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in February 2018. Kadokawa began publishing the novel through its Sneaker Bunko label in November 2019, featuring illustrations by Noboru Kannatsuki ( Goblin Slayer ). The 13th volume was released on April 1.

Yukari Higa ( Zero no Tsukaima Chevalier ) began drawing a manga adaptation on the Young Ace UP web magazine in August 2020. Kadokawa published the third volume on January 8.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English in December 2021. The second manga volume went on sale in January 2025, with the 12th light novel volume scheduled for a November 10 release.

title: Magical Explorer TV Anime Reveals More Cast, October Debut, Theme Song Artist in Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed on Friday the anime will debut on October 3. The staff also revealed a second key visual, a second promotional video, more cast and staff, and the theme song information.

ASCA performs the show's opening theme song "Remedy" and the ending theme song "Double Wings." The above video previews the opening theme.

The series will debut on October 3 at 24:00 (effectively October 4 at 12:00 a.m.) on Tokyo MX , Tochigi TV , Gunma TV , and BS11 . The anime will also air on Tohoku Broadcasting, TV Aichi , and YTV .

New cast members include:

• Mai Fuchigami as Marino Hanamura

• Minami Tsuda as Hatsumi Hanamura

• Risa Tsumugi as Claris

• Asaki Yuikawa as Iori Hijiri

• Hikaru Tōno as Rina Katō

Additional staff members include:

• Prop Design: Yaeko Watanabe, Yūkei Yamada

• Monster Design: Naoto Hosoda

• Effect Design: Hiroshi Yakou

• Art Director: Yūki Yokoyama

• Color Design: Eriko Murata

• Director of Photography: Shinya Kuwabara

• 3D Director: Haruka Sakaguchi

• Special Effects and 2D Works: Keiko Ōnishi

• Editing: Masahiro Gotō

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

• Sound Effects: Toshiya Wada

• Executive Producer: Gaku Iwasa

• Animation Producer: Shin'ichirō Katō

The anime will star:

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Kōsuke Takioto

• Ai Kakuma as Ludie

• Saori Ōnishi as Yukine Mizumori

• M.A.O as Nanami

Kazuki Ohashi ( Shadows House ) is directing the anime at WHITE FOX . Satoko Sekine ( TsukiPro the Animation ) is handling series composition. Ryosuke Kimiya ( Grimoire of Zero ) is designing the characters. Kenichiro Suehiro ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- ) is composing the music.

Yen Press is publishing the light novel series and Yukari Higa 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

Living in the world of Magical★Explorer, the legendary erotic game, sounds like a dream. Problem is, I reincarnated not as the lady-killer protagonist with his overpowered cheat skills, but as his unlucky comic-relief best friend!

The novel series debuted in February 2018 on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website. Kadokawa began publishing the light novel series in November 2019. The 13th volume shipped on April 1.

The manga adaptation launched in Young Ace Up in August 2020. Kadokawa published the manga's third compiled book volume on January 8.

title: Atelier Resleriana: Forgotten Alchemy and the Polar Night Liberator Smartphone Game Ends Service in Japan on November 25
content:
The game debuted for iOS and Android in Japan in September 2023, and launched globally for iOS, Android, and PC via Steam in January 2024. The English version ended service in March 2025.

The story follows fledgling alchemist Resna, her best friend and beastgirl knight Isana, self-proclaimed "handsome adventurer" Roman, and Resna's alchemy teacher Saskia. Resna aims to bring the forgotten art of alchemy to the world.

Takahiro ( Yuki Yuna Is a Hero , Chained Soldier ) is in charge of the story and series composition. Series creator Shinichi Yoshiike is supervising. Umiu Geso ( Cardfight!! Vanguard , Fire Emblem Heroes ) and tokki are designing the characters.

Koei Tecmo released the Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian ( Kurenai no Renkinjutsushi to Shiro no Shugosha: Resleriana no Atelier ) game in the West for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in September 2025. The game launched for the same systems plus PlayStation 4 in Japan on the same day.

The game is a single-player alchemy RPG and a "completely offline" title. The game features new protagonists, Rias Eidreise and Slade Clauslyter, and an original story.

Takahiro ( Yuki Yuna Is a Hero , Chained Soldier ) is in charge of the story and series composition. Series creator Shinichi Yoshiike is supervising. Umiu Geso ( Cardfight!! Vanguard , Fire Emblem Heroes ) and tokki are designing the characters.

Koei Tecmo released the Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian ( Kurenai no Renkinjutsushi to Shiro no Shugosha: Resleriana no Atelier ) game in the West for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in September 2025. The game launched for the same systems plus PlayStation 4 in Japan on the same day.
The game is a single-player alchemy RPG and a "completely offline" title. The game features new protagonists, Rias Eidreise and Slade Clauslyter, and an original story.

title: A "New World" Appears in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 46 Preview
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 6 (Episode 46 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes. In the previous episode, Orihime took a stand after Ichigo’s new Blood Chains Bankai form proved to be no match for Yhwach.

The fifth episode is titled “THE END,” and it will premiere on Saturday, August 29. You can see the synopsis and preview images below.

Morning dawns over Wahrwelt, and before Ichigo stretches a “new world.” Though pained by the cruel reality before him, Ichigo still has a mission he must fulfill in order to save the Three Worlds. Meanwhile, the battle between Uryu and Haschwalth intensifies as it moves toward its conclusion. At last, the “End” that holds the fate of everything in its hands is about to begin.

ALSO READ: Interview: Ichigo Voice Actors Masakazu Morita and Johnny Yong Bosch Talk BLEACH BLEACH JET Artbook and Ryogo Narita’s School Life Novel Return, Fan Vote and 2027 Exhibition Announced

BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 46 Staff:

• Script: Tomohisa Taguchi

• Storyboard: Itoko Nagai

• Episode Director: Itoko Nagai

• Chief Animation Director: Yukio Hasegawa

• Animation Directors: Saeko Ozawa

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Original TV Anime Reveals 8 More Cast Members, October 7 Debut
content:
Good Smile Company announced on Friday eight new cast members for its original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine). The company also revealed the anime will debut on Tokyo TV , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV on October 7 at 24:30 (effectively October 8 at 12:30 a.m.). The anime will also air on Chūkyō TV and MBS .

The new cast members include:

The anime stars:

• Takuma Terashima as Gekiha Shijima

• Haruka Shiraishi as Akane Kuzumi

• Saya Aizawa as Kirei Shijima

Yi Cao is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS and Kayac Animation . Toshiki Inoue (various Kamen Rider series, Death Note ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. robin is designing the characters. Majiro ( Macross Delta ) is the original character designer. An ( GOD BRAVE STUDIO ) is the mechanical designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) is the sound director.

Takanori Nishikawa is performing the opening theme song.

The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

TOGUCHI is drawing a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Dengeki Daioh magazine.

The anime is the first project in the Good Smile Company 's "The God of Combined Series" ("Gattaishin Series"). The anime commemorates Good Smile Company 's 25th anniversary.
